text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hear someone saying that Nice Nature
is by the
riverbank, so I head there to
look for her.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Not good enough... I need to be more
aware
while I run...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
And keep your spirits high, Nature.
Don't get all
gloomy. Cheer up!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Come on, remember. Think carefully.
How do I
run?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
In the Kyoto Shimbun Hai... I wasn't
confident,
but I had to keep going, no
matter what.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
In the Naruo Kinen, I told myself to keep
my mind
clear and look ahead.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
And then I made up my mind during the
Kokura
Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I just have to be me and keep moving
forward,
one step at a time.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Even if I don't know if I'll ever reach my
goal...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to face my challenges with
everything
I've got.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Sure, I'd be lying if I said I'm all
confident now...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
But there's no way out of this either.
That's why I
definitely have to face Teio!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ughhh... You always spoil me with your
kindness.
choice_data_list: ネイチャならできるよ

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You shouldn't keep doing that or I'll get
too
attached. You might end up stuck
with me
forever...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Wait, how long have you been
there?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah... actually, don't tell me. I feel like
that could
potentially devastate me.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: It's more like... I mean it is training, but...
choice_data_list: 今は何のトレーニングを？

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I was trying to figure out if I had some
type of
edge I could utilize. Anything to
get myself closer
to winning.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I figure the key is just before the finish. I
really
have to nail the homestretch.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, when you stop and think about
it... 3,000
meters is a huge distance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In a 3,000-meter race, unless she judges
the
timing of her last spurt well, it'll be
difficult for
her to compete even on the
final straight.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I want Nice Nature to run as free as
possible so
that her bright smile stays on
her face after the
race.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Earth to Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: That's such generic advice...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I unintentionally said what was meant to
be
encouragement for myself out loud.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Pfft, haha, hahaha! Come on, Trainer!
Your face
tells me everything I need to
know.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Sigh... But yeah, let's do our best.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
With no way out, I have to keep moving
forward.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: By the way, are you free right now?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best, so... it'd be nice if you
could watch
over me.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Heh, you're sweet.
choice_data_list: こちらこそお願いしたく

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: All right, let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I mean, the harder I work, the better the
trophies
I get from you, right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hahaha!
